title: Applying the double angle formula for tangent
text: Recall the double angle formula for tangent: tan(2alpha) $$=$$ (2tan(alpha))/(1 - tan(alpha)**2).

title: Alternatively, use sine and cosine
text: Alternatively, you can use the identity tan(2alpha) $$=$$ $$\fracsin^c\left(2\alpha\right)os\left(2\alpha\right)}$$ if you have already found sin(2alpha) and cos(2alpha).

title: Identify tan(alpha)
text: If sin(alpha) $$=$$ $$\frac{3}{5}$$ and cos(alpha) $$=$$ $$\frac{4}{5}$$, what is tan(alpha)?
